Botched is a fantastic verb meaning to
mess something up clumsily or perform a
task poorly. It implies incompetence.
You'll hear this in news reports about
failed robberies or surgeries, but also
in casual slang for any bad mistake.
The mechanic botched the repair and now
the car won't start. It means the work
was done very poorly and failed.
